title: Folded color proof
description: Three movable color stops paint a sharply folded paper proof, making color placement and material shading visible together.
useCase: Art directing a gradient against dimensional artwork rather than judging it only in a flat swatch.
interaction: Drag a color stop or use its arrow keys, then edit the selected color
reducedMotion: Color and position edits are immediate; reduced motion removes the small selection lift transition.
limitations: Three fixed editable stops, original SVG folded-paper geometry, and authored face lighting. No add/remove, CSS parser, color-space conversion, or physically based renderer. Coincident stops remain independently reachable with Tab.
look: Near-black canvas with a zigzag folded-paper strip shaded vermilion to magenta to aubergine, above a gradient track with rounded swatch handles and monospace hex readout.
motion: Dragging a stop handle or pressing arrow keys moves it along the track and repaints the folded proof's gradient live; the selected handle lifts 2 px over 120 ms.
adapt: Stops live in `stops` (seeded from `initial`); `change` clamps positions and `sorted` feeds both the `gradient` track string and the SVG `linearGradient`. Replace `folds` and the face lighting with your artwork, or bind `gradient` to a real fill.
